pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: The dark patches exhibit high-frequency, irregular serrations along their boundaries, creating a distinct 'toothed' edge profile. Pixel gradients at the edges are sharp. Spatial area of patches is maximal on the upper neck and shoulder, transitioning to smaller, more fragmented geometries on the lower flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: The light-colored corridors form a continuous topological lattice with clear tri-radial junction nodes. Pathway thickness is relatively high and uniform across the shoulder region, narrowing significantly as the network extends toward the posterior flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane presents a short, bristly 1D contour along the upper neck with high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations clearly silhouetted against the background.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of two avian commensals (oxpeckers) located on the dorsal ridge and posterior flank. A localized region of yellowish-green pixel discoloration is visible on the lower-posterior flank.
